title: Giants driven out by Joshua settle on Sardinia

tellings.quote: I think that Joshua drove out a lot of the giants that weren't killed in the conquest.

plain: When the biblical leader Joshua conquered the land of Canaan, many of the giants who were not killed were driven out and ended up settling on the Mediterranean island of Sardinia. The researcher Tim Alberino puts this forward himself, reading it out of the Old Testament, saying he thinks Joshua "drove out a lot of the giants that weren't killed in the conquest." It would explain, in his view, where the giants of the Bible went.
